20261121-chemistry-g12-2.material: [H3 Qorannoo Keemistirii (Olaanaa)] Rakkoo qaaccessa baay'inaa Wal-qixxaatinsa Chemikaalaa fi Saffisa Rakkoo waliin walqabatu. Faldhaan asiidii $A$ $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ qaba fi faldhaan $B$ $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$ qaba. Qabiyyeen ayoonii haayidiroojiinii $A$ keessaa isa $B$ caalaa dachaa meeqaan guddata?

Qabiyyeen ayoonii haayidiroojiinii $A$ keessaa isa $B$ caalaa dachaa meeqaan guddata?
20261121-chemistry-g12-2.s.s1.explain:
Tarkaanfii 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Tarkaanfii 2: Reeshoon $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.
Tarkaanfii 3: Faldhaan $A$ isa $B$ caalaa dachaa 100 guddaadha.

Haala kanaan gaazii kana $0.2\text{ mol}$ qabiyyeen isaa $\text{L}$ meeqa ta'a?
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.s.s1.prompt: [H3 Qorannoo Keemistirii] Gaaffii qabiyyee gaazii Wal-qixxaatinsa Chemikaalaa fi Saffisa Rakkoo waliin walqabatu. $25^\circ\text{C}$ fi $1\text{ atm}$ irratti qabiyyeen moolarii gaazii $24.5\text{ L/mol}$ dha. Haala kanaan gaazii kana $0.2\text{ mol}$ qabiyyeen isaa $\text{L}$ meeqa ta'a?
20261122-chemistry-g12-1.s.s1.explain:
Tarkaanfii 1: Akka seera Avoogaadrootti qabiyyeen $V = n \times V_m$.
Tarkaanfii 2: $V = 0.2\text{ mol} \times 24.5\text{ L/mol}$.
Tarkaanfii 3: Shallaggiin $V = 4.90\text{ L}$ kenna.
